name: CUSCAPI
recent: 并提议 RM190m 的资本削减以抵消累计亏损。公司也出现董事会变动，包括董事 Jayakumar 辞职。最新季度营收环比下降 4.4%，净利环比下降 28.2%，但同比仍增长。
notable: 已获 Bursa Securities 批准上市最多 94,488,400 股配售股。
董事 Jayakumar A/L Panneer Selvam 辞去非独立非执行董事及审计委员会成员职务。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
公司涉及重大诉讼（MATERIAL LITIGATION）。
主要股东 Wong Thean Soon 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日发出停止成为主要股东通知。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度营收为 RM7.55m，环比下降 4.4%，同比增长 3.1%；净利为 RM0.79m，环比下降 28.2%，同比增长 149.9%；净利率为 10.4%，低于上季度的 13.8%。

recent_en: Cuscapi has proposed a private placement of up to 10% and a RM190m capital reduction to offset accumulated losses. The company also saw boardroom changes, including the resignation of director Jayakumar. Latest quarterly revenue fell 4.4% QoQ and net profit dropped 28.2% QoQ, though still higher YoY.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10%, with Bursa Securities approving the listing of up to 94,488,400 placement shares.
Proposed RM190m capital reduction to offset accumulated losses.
Director Jayakumar A/L Panneer Selvam resigned as Non-Independent Non-Executive Director and Audit Committee member.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The company is involved in material litigation.
Substantial shareholder Wong Thean Soon ceased to be a substantial shareholder on 17 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM7.55m, down 4.4% QoQ but up 3.1% YoY; net profit was RM0.79m, down 28.2% QoQ but up 149.9% YoY; net margin was 10.4%, lower than 13.8% in the previous quarter.
